# NonCow

> NonCow (noncow.com) helps people choose the right plant-based milk. It has an interactive quiz that recommends a dairy alternative based on use, taste, values, allergies and texture, and in-depth guides comparing oat, soy, almond, coconut, pea and other plant milks for specific uses such as coffee, tea, baking, cooking, smoothies, kids and diets.

Content is written by Øyvind Holm-Johnsen (https://www.linkedin.com/in/holmjohnsen/). The site earns commissions through the Amazon Associates program; recommendations are based on nutrition, use case and taste, and the quiz is not influenced by commissions. Articles are updated regularly and dated.

Key recommendations from the guides:

- Coffee, lattes and cappuccino: barista-edition oat milk froths best and resists curdling; barista soy milk is the high-protein runner-up.
- Iced coffee and hot chocolate: oat milk is creamiest and blends without separating.
- Matcha: barista oat milk for creaminess; oat or unsweetened soy milk for the most traditional taste.
- Chai: barista oat milk balances the spices best; full-fat coconut milk adds richness.
- Cereal: oat milk for flavor, almond milk keeps flakes crisp longest, soy milk adds the most protein.
- Overnight oats: oat milk gives the creamiest texture; base recipe is 1/2 cup oats to 1 cup plant milk.
- Smoothies and protein shakes: soy milk (7-9 g protein per cup) is the best all-round base; oat milk is creamiest.
- Highest protein: soy milk (8-9 g per cup), pea milk (8 g) and oat protein milks (8 g).
- Soy vs oat: soy wins on protein and complete amino acids; oat wins on taste, creaminess and coffee performance.
- Oat vs almond: oat wins for coffee, creaminess and sustainability; almond for low calories, smoothies and budget.
